t: You're on Narrow Street, which runs parallel to the River Thames through Limehouse in east London. It's the oldest part of Limehouse, and many of the buildings date from the eighteenth century. It used to be much narrower than it is today. The actor Ian McKellen lived here. Widely considered one of Britain's greatest actors, he's known for Shakespeare, modern theatre and fantasy films, and he was knighted in 1991. Look along the river frontage and imagine the street as it once was.
